label: Diagram 4.2
caption: Diagram 4.2 | Barrier design Loading bays For all buildings
description:
This drawing, titled "Diagram 4.2 Barrier design" in a green box at the bottom, presents two cross-section diagrams labelled (a) and (b). The text "See para 4.2" appears at the top left.

Part (a), labelled "Any building: floor or roof edge," shows a vertical line, labelled "Barrier," rising from a horizontal surface marked "Floor or roof level". A dimension line to the right of the barrier indicates the height from the floor or roof level to the top of the barrier is "At least 375mm". A zig-zag pointer line from the text "As shown in BS EN 1991-1 with its UK National Annex" points to the top of the barrier. Two short vertical dashed lines appear at the top of the diagram.

Part (b), labelled "Any building: ramp edge," shows a vertical line, labelled "Barrier," rising from a horizontal surface marked "Ramp level". A dimension line to the right of the barrier indicates the height from the ramp level to the top of the barrier is "At least 610mm". A zig-zag pointer line from the text "As shown in BS EN 1991-1 with its UK National Annex" points to the top of the barrier. Two short vertical dashed lines appear at the top of the diagram.

This drawing, titled "Diagram 4.2 Barrier design" in a green box at the bottom, presents two cross-section diagrams labeled (a) and (b). The text "See para 4.2" appears at the top left.

Part (a), labelled "Any building: floor or roof edge," shows a vertical barrier rising from a horizontal surface marked "Floor or roof level". A zig-zag line represents the top of the barrier. A dimension line indicates the barrier height is "At least 375mm". Text pointing to the barrier reads "As shown in BS EN 1991-1 with its UK National Annex".

Part (b), labelled "Any building: ramp edge," shows a vertical barrier rising from a sloped surface. The base is marked "Ramp level". The top of the barrier is again represented by a zig-zag line. A dimension line indicates the barrier height is "At least 610mm". Similar text pointing to the barrier reads "As shown in BS EN 1991-1 with its UK National Annex". Dashed vertical lines extend upwards from the top of the barrier in both diagrams.
